notes: The temporal phrase is rendered bare, so the בְּ is unrepresented while the assimilated article takes the written *the* (rules 12, 40).
The noun's article takes *the* and הוּא the written *same*; the agreement article is unrepresented (rules 41, 47).
The apodosis waw takes the frame's *that*, which the ASV writes at the head of the apodosis (rule 45).
